text:
maya: Quick sync — where are we on telemetry gating for the new token-cost attribution pipeline? Need owners + blocking deps for rollout next Wed.

samir: Owning work on the attribution transform. ETA for final event schema is EOD Tue. main blocker is a missing field from the ingest side (`request.context.route_id`).

devon: @samir I can add route_id to the frontend SDK ingest, but need the exact key name and whether it can be nullable. Also: will this be backfilled for historical samples? :thinking_face:

samir: We'll use `request.context.route_id` (string, optional). No backfill required for the initial rollout — fallback will be `unknown_route`. We'll add a small migration later.

chloe: Heads-up: infra needs a clear cutoff before we flip the aggregation job to use the new events. Can we freeze schema changes by Monday 23:59 PT?

maya: Freeze by Mon 23:59 PT sounds good. Samir/devon — can you confirm whether that gives you enough time to get the SDK + producer changes in?

samir: Yes, I’ll open the PR today with schema docs and unit tests. Tagging @analytics-bot for schema registry publish when approved.

devon: I’ll land the SDK change + publish a minor version by Mon morning. Will include an integration test showing `route_id` present in the ingested event.

maya: Great. Also need clarity on cost attribution mapping: which models will map to `model_tier` vs `model_variant` fields? We should lock that now to avoid rework in the billing feed.

samir: Proposal: `model_tier` = family (e.g., gpt-4, mixing small/big families), `model_variant` = exact model id + quantization suffix (e.g., gpt-4o-8k.q4_0). That keeps aggregates simple.

chloe: That mapping looks fine to finance, as long as we provide a consistent normalization table. I'll own the normalization table and keep it in the docs repo under `analytics/cost-mapping.md`.

maya: Perfect. Blockers to call out: (1) schema registry publish (samir), (2) SDK release (devon), (3) aggregation job switch plan + rollback playbook (chloe/infra). Anyone else?

chloe: I'll draft the rollback playbook and an SLO smoke test checklist. Will put the PR into `eng-platform` for review by Tue.

analytics-bot: Reminder — schema registry requires an explicit `compatibility: BACKWARD` flag for additions. Please include that in the publish PR.

samir: Noted. I'll set `compatibility: BACKWARD` and include an example event in the PR.

devon: Ping me for code review once PRs are up. I’ll run the integration test matrix (local + staging).

maya: Action items summary: samir -> publish schema + PR, devon -> SDK + publish, chloe -> rollback playbook + normalization table, maya -> coordinate rollout window and communicate to finance + product. Freeze Monday 23:59 PT. Rollout target Wed. Any objections? :+1: / :-1:

samir: +1

devon: +1

chloe: +1

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short checklist in this thread when PRs are ready.
